title: ACE-CORE.sys — research artifact
summary: Aftermath Labs reports recovering 150 of 167 virtualized functions in ACE-CORE.sys, one of four named ACE kernel-driver artifacts. Its published recovery limits matter as much as the successful results when evaluating the research.
